name: swag-mcp
description: SWAG reverse proxy configuration management via MCP. Create, edit, view, and manage nginx proxy configurations with auth integration.

swag_mcp_proxy_confs_path.title: SWAG Proxy Configs Path
swag_mcp_proxy_confs_path.description: Container/local path where SWAG proxy configurations are mounted, e.g. /proxy-confs.

swag_mcp_proxy_confs_uri.title: SWAG Proxy Configs URI
swag_mcp_proxy_confs_uri.description: Optional local path or SSH URI for SWAG proxy configs. Overrides SWAG_MCP_PROXY_CONFS_PATH when set.

swag_mcp_swag_log_base_path.title: SWAG Log Base Path
swag_mcp_swag_log_base_path.description: Base path for SWAG log files on the SWAG host or container.

swag_mcp_log_directory.title: SWAG MCP Log Directory
swag_mcp_log_directory.description: Directory for SWAG MCP server logs.

swag_mcp_host.title: SWAG MCP Host
swag_mcp_host.description: Host interface the MCP server binds to. Docker deployments normally use 0.0.0.0.

swag_mcp_port.title: SWAG MCP Port
swag_mcp_port.description: Published host port for the HTTP MCP server.

swag_mcp_url.title: SWAG MCP URL
swag_mcp_url.description: Public HTTP MCP endpoint including /mcp, e.g. https://swag.example.com/mcp.

swag_mcp_token.title: SWAG MCP Token
swag_mcp_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate HTTP MCP requests.

swag_mcp_default_web_auth_method.title: Default Web Endpoint Auth Method
swag_mcp_default_web_auth_method.description: Default SWAG/nginx auth method for generated web endpoints. This is not MCP server authentication.

swag_mcp_default_quic_enabled.title: Default QUIC Enabled
swag_mcp_default_quic_enabled.description: Whether generated SWAG configs enable QUIC by default.

fastmcp_server_auth.title: FastMCP Auth Provider
fastmcp_server_auth.description: Optional FastMCP auth provider class, e.g. fastmcp.server.auth.providers.google.GoogleProvider.

fastmcp_server_auth_google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
fastmcp_server_auth_google_client_id.description: Google OAuth client ID for FastMCP authentication.

fastmcp_server_auth_google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
fastmcp_server_auth_google_client_secret.description: Google OAuth client secret for FastMCP authentication.

fastmcp_server_auth_google_base_url.title: Google OAuth Base URL
fastmcp_server_auth_google_base_url.description: Public OAuth/MCP endpoint, including /mcp for path-mounted deployments.

fastmcp_server_auth_resource_base_url.title: OAuth Resource Base URL
fastmcp_server_auth_resource_base_url.description: Public resource origin used for protected resource metadata.

fastmcp_server_auth_google_required_scop.title: Google OAuth Required Scopes
fastmcp_server_auth_google_required_scop.description: Comma-separated OAuth scopes required by FastMCP Google authentication.

fastmcp_server_auth_google_redirect_path.title: Google OAuth Redirect Path
fastmcp_server_auth_google_redirect_path.description: Redirect callback path for FastMCP Google OAuth.

swag_mcp_backup_retention_days.title: Backup Retention Days
swag_mcp_backup_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain generated config backup files.

swag_mcp_log_level.title: Log Level
swag_mcp_log_level.description: Server log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

swag_mcp_rate_limit_enabled.title: Rate Limit Enabled
swag_mcp_rate_limit_enabled.description: Whether request rate limiting middleware is enabled.

swag_mcp_rate_limit_rps.title: Rate Limit RPS
swag_mcp_rate_limit_rps.description: Requests per second limit when rate limiting is enabled.

swag_mcp_rate_limit_burst.title: Rate Limit Burst
swag_mcp_rate_limit_burst.description: Burst capacity above the configured requests-per-second limit.

swag_mcp_health_check_insecure.title: Health Check Insecure
swag_mcp_health_check_insecure.description: Disable TLS verification for health checks. Use only for development/internal networks.
